note: Recorded provenance for binary and licence assets committed to this repository, checked by scripts/verify-provenance.mjs. This is a LOCK, not a live upstream check: it proves each committed file still hashes to the value that was reviewed, so an asset cannot be swapped without a visible edit here. The upstream relationship itself was established by hand at review time. The retrieval URL is deliberately NOT stored; it is derived from repository + commit + path so the record cannot contradict itself. The commit is pinned and must be a full SHA, because a branch can be rewritten and would then no longer return the reviewed artifact.

assets.why: Read by scripts/generate-signature.cjs to produce src/constants/signature.ts. Committed so a clean clone can regenerate the signature.
The OFL requires the licence and copyright notice to accompany the font when it is redistributed. Taken from the same upstream commit as the binary, not a different distribution.
